answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 10165 Country: India Title: Assalamu Aalaikum i wish to know if i am reading Quran e pak and i hear azaan should i stop reading imediately? Question: Assalamu Aalaikum i wish to know if i am reading Quran e pak and i hear azaan should i stop reading imediately? Answer ID: 10165 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 66/66=M/1429) Yes, while azan is called it is better to stop the recitation of the Quran ( tilawah ) and respond back the azan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
